english.title: Use / cause / permit a vehicle to be used with an insecure load on part of Gatwick Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Gatwick Airport - London to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..),

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

when the load carried by the vehicle was not so secure and in such a position that neither danger nor nuisance was caused or was likely to be caused to any person or property by reason of the load or any part thereof falling or being blown from such vehicle, or by reason of any other movement of the load or any part thereof in relation to such vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 5(8)(b) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
